meta.source: ScapeMedia brand decisions by Karan Targotra, 27 Nov 2026 (red, black, white); type pairing from Karan's personal design system v2; red #E10600 from the ScapeMedia onboarding PDFs and website v2

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: ScapeMedia Red, the one brand colour. Punch word, key numbers in documents, arrows, primary buttons, links. 4.97:1 on white, so safe at any size on white and light grey.

tokens.name: red-bright
tokens.usage: Red on black grounds for text under 24px (5.6:1 on black). Never on white.

tokens.name: red-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed / hover state of red buttons on white (7.3:1 with white text).

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: ScapeMedia Black. Ink on white, dark section and footer grounds, document covers.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: ScapeMedia White. Default page ground and ink on black.

tokens.name: gray-950
tokens.usage: Raised surface on black: cards and panels inside dark sections.

tokens.name: gray-600
tokens.usage: Muted text on white (6.7:1) and light grey (6.1:1).

tokens.name: gray-50
tokens.usage: Alternate section ground on white pages; input fields.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternate sections, cards and panels on surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on surface and surface-alt.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting text, captions, labels, meta lines.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The red element of a section: punch word, arrow, link, step number.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Primary button and the red CTA band fill. White text on it (4.97:1).

groups.name: Website
groups.note: Serif headline carries the sentence, one Plus Jakarta Sans punch word carries the payoff, Inter for everything you read. Sizes are desktop; mobile in each usage note.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero headline only. Mobile 44px. Max ~8 words.

styles.name: punch
styles.usage: One uppercase word inside a display or h2 headline, in accent. Same size as the headline it sits in.

styles.name: h2
styles.sample: Built for businesses that want to grow

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Meta Ads, Google Ads and lead generation for growing businesses in Jammu & Kashmir.
styles.usage: Paragraph under a hero or section headline, in ink-muted. Mobile 17px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We plan, run and optimise campaigns around one question: is the spend bringing in customers?

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a headline, in accent, with a 24px red rule before it.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Results depend on offer, budget and market.

groups.name: Documents (A4 PDF, proposals, audits)
groups.note: Same pairing in print. Sizes in pt for A4.

styles.name: doc-number
styles.usage: Section and step numbers, in red (28pt).

styles.name: doc-body
styles.sample: Campaigns are reviewed weekly against cost per lead and lead quality.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Sections, photos, document blocks. Square by default.

shadow.note: Flat brand. One soft shadow for cards that float over photos or forms.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Form card and floating panels only.
